text:
sophie: Morning — quick standup for the AMS prewarm work.
What I did: rolled the prewarm script changes to canary, measured cold-start drop ~28% on p3-like instances.
Blockers: quota request for spot pool still pending (ticket AI-998). Some attach failures observed during the canary.
Today: follow up with cloud rep, open PR for telemetry (prewarm telemetry), enable a short fallback policy if quota not granted. ping @maria for quota escalation? :wave:

maria: Ack — I'll reach out to the GCP rep this morning. Shared console link in the ticket. We might need to split the request across two projects to speed approvals.

devin: Re: PR — left an inline on the backoff loop (sleep vs expo backoff). Also noticed attach errors last night in eu-west, pasted logs below for context:
```
2026-03-16T22:14:02Z attach: attempt=3 instance=eu-west-1a code=AttachFailed
2026-03-16T22:14:07Z attach: attempt=4 instance=eu-west-1a code=RateLimit
2026-03-16T22:14:15Z kube: pod prewarm-job-xyz Pending: waiting for volume attach
```

sophie: Thanks — I'll switch to expo backoff. For the attach failures, @liam any visibility? infra-bot posted a pool alert a few minutes ago. :eyes:

liam: Yep, autoscaler hit the max-stable threshold because a nodegroup rollout failed (bad template), caused a transient drain. Fixed the template and triggered a rollback; new nodes coming up now. ETA ~15m to stabilize. I also opened a quota bump request for EU earlier.

infra-bot: ALERT: Pool "ams-spot" capacity at 8% for instance-family p3; autoscaler active, reclaimed nodes. Created ticket AI-998 (autoscale-failures).

maria: Added a note to AI-998 — we can enable fallback to reserved capacity for critical prewarm jobs to avoid regressions. Suggest toggling fallback for next 2 hours and monitoring token spend. cc @sophie :white_check_mark:

sophie: Good plan. I'll enable fallback for prewarm batch jobs for 2h and add a short-lived alert at 20% pool capacity in the Console. Also updating the PR to include telemetry tags so we can trace prewarm cost vs savings.

devin: Heads up for owners with strict latency SLOs — remind teams to pin to dedicated pools or Dedicated Capacity. Also pinging for CR review: PR #1982 (prewarm telemetry).

sophie: @devin I replied to your comment, will push the fix and re-request review today.

liam: Quick update: EU quota request id 789 was partially approved for +10 GPUs, should be provisioned in ~2h. If we need more immediately, escalate to the on-call quota channel.

sophie: Blocker partially resolved (partial quota approved). If the pool stabilizes, we'll keep fallback off after 2h. If problems persist, we'll re-open this thread. Thanks all — reconvene in ~30m if any more alerts. :white_check_mark:
